premises.text: In-car tech ages fast while a billion existing vehicles are left out of new OEM stacks
premises.evidence_span: aren't you afraid that a year from now, this technology will be completely outdated

premises.text: VINLY OBD device plus app catalog brings safety, savings, and fun services to post-1996 cars at set device prices
premises.evidence_span: The device plugs into your car under the dash

premises.text: Same platform sells fleet tracking/custom business apps with device and data plan included yearly
premises.evidence_span: that's only for $149.99 per year, and that includes the device and includes the data plan

premises.text: Developers get a full API/SDK/hardware backpack stack to build across all makes instead of siloed OEM investments
premises.evidence_span: developers could not build applications for the car without considerable investment. And even with the limited capacity where they can, they're usually siloed within a car manufacturer make and model

value.text: Connected-car applications and services for consumers, fleets, and developers
value.evidence_span: VINLY is a connected car platform that enables building applications and services for your car

causal_links.evidence_span: more than one billion vehicles on the road right now
enable developers to get a huge piece of this market

notes: Price kept with consumer hardware (v1.3.1 #3). Enterprise folded with consumer device as same plug-in platform commercial offer; developer openness as separate module.
